Title: Plug-in ECU 1989–93
Body (HTML):
A rusEFI engine computer for the 1989–93 Mazda MX-5 Miata (NA · 1.6). It fits the stock ECU case and plugs into the stock harness connector. Two boards: the universal daughterboard that runs the engine, and a motherboard made for your model year.

The 1989–93 manual cars have a throttle switch rather than a throttle position sensor. For closed-loop idle and throttle-based acceleration fuel, add a 0–5 V sensor on the stock plug: two 0 Ω links on the board.

Fits1989–93 MX-5 Miata, manual and manual-swapped
ConnectorStock 48-pin (2 plugs)
ProcessorSTM32F407, running rusEFI
WidebandBuilt-in LSU 4.9 controller
MAP sensor700 kPa absolute, on the board
Outputs8 low-side drivers, 7 protected relay and lamp outputs, 4 ignition
TuningTunerStudio over USB-C
You addA Bosch LSU 4.9 sensor (it fits the stock front oxygen sensor's hole) and its lead, a vacuum hose to the intake manifold, your stock ECU case
SEO Description: Plug-in ECU 1989–93: a plug-in rusEFI engine computer for the Mazda MX-5 Miata.
